why: Vendored so this suite does not read another repository's WORKING TREE. tests/test_source_profile_artifacts.py read ~/Work/RefSpec/portfolio/resource-catalog-v0.json directly, so spicy-docs went red whenever RefSpec had uncommitted work -- a failure in this repository with its cause in another one, and nothing in the failure to say so.
whyThisCommitAndNotRefspecHead: This is the catalog state spicy-docs' committed policies/profile-resource-applicability-v0.json was generated against, established by testing each candidate rather than assumed. RefSpec HEAD has moved past it and the suite FAILS against HEAD -- see knownDrift. Pinning HEAD would have shipped a red suite; regenerating the applicability artifact to match HEAD would be a policy change, which is not a test fix and is not this commit's business.
